heroHeadline: Brugada Presents Second Government Report to CDMX Congress
heroSubtitle: On October 14 Clara Brugada delivered her Second Government Report before the Mexico City Congress. The Congress review (glosa) runs October 20 to November 16, with 23 officials scheduled to appear.
footerNote: Data sourced from official CDMX government reports (Gobierno CDMX, SSC, SACMEX, SEMOVI, CAMe, CONAGUA, FGJ-CDMX, Congreso CDMX), INEGI, Fiscalía CDMX, NASA, La Jornada, El Universal, Proceso, Milenio, Infobae México, N+, El Financiero, El Sol de México, Excélsior, La Crónica de Hoy, La Razón, La Silla Rota, El Heraldo de México, Argonmexico, Reuters, AP, Euronews, US News, and institutional analyses from UNAM, IMCO, México Evalúa, and the Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP).
